theme.name: Psycho-Somatic Calm & Vitality
theme.description: High-end medical-wellness aesthetic combining grounding dark teal (#1F5F5B) and energizing terracotta coral (#E8704A) on pristine soft ivory and white backgrounds with modern glassmorphism and subtle elevation.

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-[#E8704A] to-[#F17E5B] px-8 py-4 text-lg font-bold text-white shadow-xl shadow-[#E8704A]/30 transition-all duration-300 hover:from-[#DF633D] hover:to-[#E8704A] hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-[#E8704A]/40 hover:-translate-y-0.5 active:translate-y-0 cursor-pointer border-b-4 border-[#014D82]
buttons.secondary: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-[#1F5F5B] px-6 py-3 text-base font-semibold text-white shadow-md hover:bg-[#174946] transition-all cursor-pointer
buttons.outline: inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-[#1F5F5B] px-6 py-3 text-base font-bold text-[#1F5F5B] hover:bg-[#1F5F5B] hover:text-white transition-all cursor-pointer

cards.light: bg-white rounded-3xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xl shadow-slate-900/5 p-6 sm:p-8 hover:border-[#1F5F5B]/30 hover:shadow-2xl hover:shadow-[#1F5F5B]/10 transition-all duration-300
cards.teal: bg-[#1F5F5B] text-white rounded-3xl p-6 sm:p-8 border border-white/10 shadow-xl
cards.accent: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#FFF8F5] to-white rounded-3xl border border-[#E8704A]/20 shadow-lg p-6 sm:p-8

badge.hero: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#1F5F5B] text-white text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold shadow-sm border border-white/20 tracking-wide uppercase
badge.accent: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-[#FFF3EE] text-[#E8704A] text-xs font-bold border border-[#E8704A]/20
